sources.excerpt: Guitar FX Layouts: DeadAstronautFX Space Patrol Fuzz Guitar FX Layouts Here's a collection of vero (stripboard) and tagboard guitar and bass effect layouts that we have put together covering many classic and popular effects in growing numbers. Many of these have been posted on freestompboxes.org, so check that site out for great discussions on building your own effect pedals. Enjoy the builds and please also visit us on Facebook and Twitter Pages Home Layout Guide Components Build Guide Offboard Faults Kits Forum Site Map NEW Wednesday, 25 January 2017 DeadAstronautFX Space Patrol Fuzz Deadastronaut's version of the Big Muff. Original DIY thread and schematic are available here . There's also another great layout by Mug in the Forum section. Posted by Alex at 11:04 Email This BlogThis!
